subject.title: improve(gateway): speed up pristine plugin-heavy startup [AI]

question: Does the Gateway/doctor owner approve using the prepared pristine-core-state fact to skip core legacy migration discovery while retaining plugin migrations and full handling for recovered or stateful configurations?
rationale: This changes migration and startup-checkpoint routing for existing code paths, and tests cannot alone establish the intended compatibility boundary for every shipped state layout.

options.title: Approve after full green proof
options.body: Land the optimization after all exact-head checks pass and an owner confirms the pristine-state predicate covers every supported external-state and recovery path.

options.title: Require broader upgrade proof
options.body: Pause merge until fresh-install and representative tagged-upgrade scenarios demonstrate that existing core state never takes the core-only skip path.

options.title: Retain full migration discovery
options.body: Close or rework the PR if the conservative pristine-state invariant cannot be proven without adding fragile runtime discovery or fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve after full green proof
recommendation.body: Land the optimization after all exact-head checks pass and an owner confirms the pristine-state predicate covers every supported external-state and recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available discussion shows direct ownership of the performance investigation, implementation, recovery-edge correction, and supplied proof.
